name: campus-commerce
description: Campus marketplace — Next.js frontend + Express/PostgreSQL backend

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
